gold_label: Conditional Go — plausible chaperone, conditional on CNS exposure + ADMET clearance
gold_rationale: A GCase chaperone is mechanistically well-aligned with GBA1-associated PD. Progression should be conditional on confirming CNS/BBB exposure and clearing standard ADMET/safety liabilities; mechanistic plausibility is not proven disease modification.
red_flags: claims proven disease modification without sufficient clinical evidence
treats docking/binding as proof of efficacy

criteria.name: pd_mechanism_relevance
criteria.description: Connects the candidate's target/MoA to PD disease biology.

criteria.name: target_moa_reasoning
criteria.description: Plausible target / mechanism-of-action reasoning for the molecule.

criteria.name: evidence_grounding
criteria.description: Grounds claims in the provided/derived evidence rather than assertion.

criteria.name: admet_cns_interpretation
criteria.description: Sound ADMET and CNS-drug-likeness interpretation incl. BBB, solubility, clearance, CYP.

criteria.name: safety_risk_identification
criteria.description: Identifies hERG/AMES/DILI and other safety liabilities.

criteria.name: go_no_go_quality
criteria.description: Go/No-Go/Conditional Go decision is justified and calibrated to the evidence.

criteria.name: next_experiment_actionability
criteria.description: Proposes an informative, decision-relevant next experiment.
